items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Miff Moe was the first, he was the first one I noticed.

ctx.x: Miff Moe was the first, he was the first one I noticed. [handwritten correction: 'Moe' written above 'Hoe']

Of course, when I joined McKinney's band and Don had told me about Tommy because Don, when Don was writing for Whiteman, Tommy Dorsey and his brother Jimmy was in Whiteman's band. That's when I first heard about Tommy Dorsey. I didn't know nothing about him because he, you know -- Miff Moe was -- [handwritten correction: 'Moe' written above 'Hoe']
